content.text: All responsive locations are strongly Customer-favourable; no redline is warranted.

input.quote: Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. § 14.2 vests ownership of each Deliverable in Customer with an express present assignment (plus personnel assignments and further-assurances); § 14.3 confirms Vendor keeps only Vendor Technology (defined in § 1.9 as its pre-existing technology, expressly excluding Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP), and § 13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" to embedded Vendor Technology including rights to modify and create derivative works. § 14.1 confirms Customer owns all Customer Data and that no right transfers to Vendor except a limited processing right for the Services, reinforced by § 15.1's bars on selling, advertising use, cross-customer combination and model training. § 14.4 negates joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument. Minor notes only, not deviations: the Customer Data processing right also references "improve the Services for Customer" rather than provision alone (bounded to Customer and backed by the § 15.1 prohibitions), and § 13.2 permits contractor support rather than a general sublicence, which the preferred position does not require.
